nodes.title: FLUX 3090 / единый workflow
widgets_values:
# Одна схема · два этапа
**1. GENERATE:** Этап OFF → промт → Run → выбери сохранённый base PNG.

**2. FINISH:** загрузи этот PNG в среднюю ноду → Этап ON → Run. Дорисовка FLUX по умолчанию OFF. Результат сохраняется автоматически.

nodes.title: 1 / GENERATE · поиск кадра
widgets_values: A cinematic landscape photograph of a solitary white lighthouse perched on a narrow island of dark volcanic rock, rising above an immense sea of low clouds. Only the highest mountain peaks emerge from the clouds in the distance. A winding stone staircase leads from the foreground through windswept golden grass toward the lighthouse. A tiny traveler in a red coat stands halfway up the stairs, emphasizing the enormous scale. Early morning sunlight breaks through a gap in the storm clouds, illuminating the lighthouse and the edges of the grass, while the valleys remain in cool blue shadow. Wisps of mist drift across the path. Weathered stone, wet basalt, delicate wildflowers, believable natural textures. Wide-angle photography, strong foreground depth, atmospheric perspective, restrained colors, subtle film grain, quiet sense of wonder.
